aggregate.note: The initial harness safety run took 168 seconds. Any subsequent documentation-only check is separate repository verification, not customer lifecycle work. No exact incremental native-only seed counterfactual was measured.

lifecycle_accounting.additional_seed_allocation: The full native cache fill is common to both warm approaches. The query is Smart-only. Remaining installation/publication/cache work mixes common and incremental costs; no measured native-only seed supports an exact net allocation.
lifecycle_accounting.conservative_view_limit: Charging the whole combined seed only to Smart overcharges common native cache fill. These values are an upper-cost illustration, not a fair measured lifecycle saving.

selection_and_outcomes.case_count_note: Targets and Bazel-reported test runs are not individual C++ test-case counts.

storage.transfer_note: Nominal compressed payload sizes from GitHub metadata, not measured wire traffic or billing. Docker image transfers are included in time but their byte volume was not metered.

decision.classification: Mixed observed latency, inconclusive attributable warm-cache benefit
decision.reason: Two faster pairs and positive median saving, but all pairs used different CPU models and native setup differences dominate the faster results. Both approaches reran the same native work. Bazel-window savings are small relative to Action preparation. Do not claim a causal speedup or expand on the headline alone.
decision.broader_cases_status: Predeclared but not run after this inconclusive initial gate. Behavioral regression, current-profile broad fallback, shared/test-only cases, evolving-base refresh costs and second-repository validation remain outstanding.

limitations: Three repetitions of one passing change are not a representative PR distribution.
No failures in this gate; no failure-recall estimate. Earlier compiler-regression evidence is separate.
All pairs expose four CPUs but CPU models differ; setup/network variance prevents exact causal attribution.
Warm describes the native disk cache, not the cold container image or every setup layer.
No measured evolving-base refresh or native-only seed counterfactual; no lifecycle ROI or amortization claim.
Profile remains reviewed Abseil GCC/C++17, not arbitrary Bazel or enterprise repository compatibility.
